newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two more bodies of Sri Lankan pilgrims who died in the Mena fire were identified. Three Sri Lankan deaths were reported earlier.
- Eastern Province Chamber of Commerce to organise the second National Tourism Exhibition on April 26 in Abha.
- Saudi Arabia's imports from ten countries in 1995 were worth 72 billion riyals.

- An Egyptian writer suggests Moslems go on haj only once in a lifetime to reduce possible fatal accidents. Saudi Arabia has said 343 people were killed and around 1,500 injured when fire gutted pilgrims' tents near Islam's holy city of Mecca.
